text: The Heinz Hopf Prize is presented every two years at ETH Zurich and recognizes exceptional contributions in pure mathematics. The award is named in honor of Heinz Hopf (1894–1971), who served as Professor of Mathematics at ETH from 1931 to 1965. The prize is conferred during the Heinz Hopf Lectures, which are delivered by the recipient at ETH. The first award was given in October 2009.
